name: Wall Push-up
description: Stand arm's length from a wall, hands on the wall at shoulder height; bend elbows to bring chest to the wall and press back.
videoChannel: The Center at Belvedere - Charlottesville, VA

name: Incline Push-up
description: Hands on an elevated surface, body straight from head to heels; lower chest to the edge and press back up.

name: Push-up
description: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line; lower chest to floor and press back up.
videoChannel: Clara del Sol - Yoga & Calisthenics Teacher

name: Diamond Push-up
description: Hands together under the chest forming a diamond shape; lower and press back up, keeping elbows close to the body.

name: Decline Push-up
description: Feet elevated on a surface, hands on the floor; lower chest to the ground and press back up.

name: Pike Push-up
description: Hips high in an inverted V, hands on the floor; lower the top of the head toward the floor and press back up.

name: Archer Push-up
description: Wide hand placement; shift weight to one side and bend that elbow while the other arm stays straight, then switch sides.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-up
description: Hands placed near the hips with fingers pointing toward the feet, torso leaning forward; perform a push-up in this lean.

name: Dips
description: Support yourself on parallel bars; lower until elbows reach roughly 90 degrees, then press back up.

name: Handstand Push-up (Wall-Assisted)
description: Kick up into a handstand against a wall; lower the head toward the floor and press back up to full lockout.

name: Dead Hang
description: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended and shoulders engaged, holding the position.

name: Australian Row
description: Lie under a low bar with body straight; pull your chest up to the bar and lower back down with control.
videoChannel: The Fitting Rooms Personal Training Gym

name: Negative Pull-up
description: Jump or step up to the top pull-up position, then lower yourself down as slowly as possible.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-up
description: Loop a resistance band around the bar and under a foot or knee to reduce bodyweight, then perform a full pull-up.

name: Pull-up
description: Hang with an overhand grip and pull your chin above the bar, then lower with control.

name: Chin-up
description: Hang with an underhand grip and pull your chin above the bar, then lower with control.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-up
description: Grip the bar wider than shoulder width and pull up until your chin clears the bar, then lower with control.

name: Archer Pull-up
description: Wide grip; pull up while shifting toward one hand, keeping the other arm extended, then switch sides.

name: Typewriter Pull-up
description: Pull up to the top and shift side to side across the bar while staying at the top, keeping chin above the bar.

name: Muscle-up
description: Pull up explosively and transition over the bar into a dip lockout in one continuous motion.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Feet shoulder-width apart; bend hips and knees to lower into a squat, then stand back up.

name: Split Squat
description: Step into a staggered stance and lower the back knee toward the floor, then push back up.

name: Lunge
description: Step forward and lower until both knees are bent near 90 degrees, then push back to standing.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated on a bench; lower the front leg into a lunge and push back up.

name: Jump Squat
description: Perform a squat and explode upward into a jump, landing softly back into the squat position.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with knees bent; drive hips upward by squeezing the glutes, then lower back down.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: From a glute bridge, extend one leg straight and drive the hips up using the planted leg only.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
description: Holding a support for balance, lower on one leg while the other leg extends forward, then push back up.
videoChannel: Girls Gone Strong | Women's Health & Fitness

name: Pistol Squat
description: Balance on one leg and lower into a full squat while the other leg stays extended forward, then stand back up.

name: Nordic Curl (Assisted)
description: Kneeling with ankles anchored, lower your torso forward as slowly as possible under hamstring control, then return.

name: Plank
description: Support your body on forearms and toes in a straight line from head to heels, bracing the core.

name: Side Plank
description: Support your body on one forearm with the body in a straight side-facing line, hips lifted off the floor.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the floor, and lift shoulders and legs off the ground into a dish shape.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise your knees toward your chest, then lower with control.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise straight legs until roughly parallel to the floor, then lower with control.

name: V-up
description: Lie flat and simultaneously lift the legs and torso, reaching hands toward feet to form a V, then lower back down.

name: Russian Twist
description: Sit with knees bent and feet lifted slightly; rotate the torso side to side, tapping the floor on each side.

name: L-sit
description: Support yourself on hands with legs extended straight out in front, forming an L shape, and hold.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Kneeling, roll the wheel forward while keeping the core braced and back flat, then pull back to start.

name: Dragon Flag (Advanced Tuck)
description: Lying on a bench and gripping behind the head, lift the body into a straight line supported only at the shoulders, tucking the knees as you lower.

name: Tuck Planche
description: From a support position, lean forward and lift the feet off the ground with knees tucked to the chest, holding the balance.

name: Advanced Tuck Planche
description: From a tuck planche, extend the hips so the knees move away from the chest while keeping the feet off the ground.

name: Straddle Planche
description: From an advanced tuck, extend the legs wide into a straddle while keeping the body parallel to the ground.

name: Full Planche
description: Support the fully extended body parallel to the ground with legs together, balanced entirely on the hands.

name: Tuck Front Lever
description: Hang from a bar and pull the knees up to the chest while rotating the body to horizontal, holding the position.

name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
description: From a tuck front lever, extend the hips so the knees move away from the chest while staying horizontal.

name: Full Front Lever
description: Hang from a bar and hold the fully extended body horizontal, parallel to the ground, facing up.

name: Freestanding Handstand
description: Balance upside down on the hands, body fully extended, without support from a wall.

name: Tuck Back Lever
description: Hang from a bar, rotate so the body faces down, and tuck the knees to the chest while holding horizontal.

name: Tuck Human Flag
description: Grip a vertical pole with both hands and lift the tucked knees off the ground, holding the body sideways against the pole.
